content: Close the four self-discipline gaps found in the agent/ design review by machine-enforcing them: index completeness, an aggregated open-decisions ledger, mandatory session distillation, staleness warnings, plus a session scaffolder to cut ceremony cost.

Index completeness becomes a validator rule: the sessions, plan, and experience README tables must exactly match the directory sets in both directions. This was prompted by a live drift: S20260828-001 and S20260828-002 were absent from the sessions index and validation stayed green; that index was backfilled in commit 957248e before the rule landed.

agent/memory/open-decisions.md becomes the aggregated ledger of all 29 unresolved decisions across M0001-M0004, each with blocking scope and closure condition; the validator requires each plan's Decisions-to-Close item count to match its ledger rows, and closed decisions leave the ledger for the decisions index.

Session summaries from 2026-08-28 onward require a Distillation section (none is valid) so reusable knowledge is forced out of cold storage; the session-summary template gains the section and S20260828-001/002 are backfilled with their actual promotions. Active plan records not updated within 14 days of the latest checkpoint emit a non-fatal staleness warning.
Extend tools/check-agent-records.py with the four rules; run positive and negative self-tests (removed index row, removed ledger row, stale Active date).

Two implementation bugs were found and fixed during self-test: anchored id patterns failed against link targets with directory prefixes (added unanchored search patterns), and a missing capture group raised IndexError. Negative tests then behaved as designed: index and ledger removals fail validation, staleness warns without failing. Positive run: ok, 3 sessions, 36 events, 57 Markdown files.
Write tools/new-session.py (id allocation, validator-clean four-file skeleton, automatic index row) and dogfood it to scaffold this very session.
Scaffold created S20260828-003-agent-record-convergence with the index row appended, and the skeleton passed validation immediately (4 sessions, 37 events) before any content was filled in.
